units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Samuel 30:12">Targ. I Sam. XXX, 12</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 33:22">Targ. Deut. XXXIII, 22</cite> <cite ref="U02097"><he>שַׁתְיָא</he></cite> (Y. II <he>שתימין</he>, corr. acc.).—Y. Shek. IV, 47ᶜ top <he>כד הוה שָׁתֵי וכ׳</he> when he had drunk the four cups of wine on the Passover night &c.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 8:1:5">Y. Sabb. VIII, beg. 11ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 10:1:11">Y. Pes. X, 37ᶜ</cite>.
<cite ref="Eruvin 64a:7">Erub. 64ᵃ</cite> <he>כל כמה דלא שָׁתֵינָא וכ׳</he> so long as I have not drunk a fourth (of a Log) of wine, my mind is not clear.
<cite ref="Shabbat 152a:4">Sabb. 152ᵃ</cite> <he>עד … מכאן ואילך מִשְׁתֵּי מעלי</he> up to forty years eating is more salutary, after that drinking is more salutary.

<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 4a:7">R. Hash. 4ᵃ</cite> <he>כלבתא בת משתי חמרא היא</he> (ed. <cite ref="M02995"><he>משתיא</he></cite>) does a bitch drink wine?; Yalk. Neh. 1069 <he>מי שַׁתְיָא חמרא</he>; a. fr.—With prefixed <he>אִשְׁתֵּי ׃א</he>, <cite ref="A03346"><he>אִישְׁ׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 34:28">Targ. O. Ex. XXXIV, 28</cite> ed. Berl. (ed. Vien. <cite ref="U02091"><he>שתי</he></cite>); Y. <he>אש׳</he>.
Targ. O. Gen. XXIV, 14 אִישְׁתְּ (ed. Vien. אֵשְׁתְּ) imperative; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Eruvin 54a:4">Erub. 54ᵃ</cite> <he>חטוף … ואִישְׁתֵּי</he> make haste and eat, make haste and drink (enjoy life, v. <cite ref="H00640"><he>חֲטַף</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 12:1">Lev. R. s. 12</cite> <he>עשרה … אִישְׁתֵּית</he> thou drankest ten &c., v. <cite ref="S01065"><he>קִיסְטָא</he> I</cite>.
<cite ref="Yevamot 65b:17">Yeb. 65ᵇ</cite> <he>אִישְׁתִּיָא סמא וכ׳</he> she drank a drug causing barrenness; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 4a:7">R. Hash. 4ᵃ</cite> <cite ref="M02995"><he>מִשְׁתָּיֵא</he></cite>, v. supra.
<cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 11:34">Targ. O. Lev. XI, 34</cite> <he>דיִשְׁתְּתֵי</he> (Y. <he>דיִשְׁתֵּיתֵי</he>; h. text <he>יִשָּׁתֶה</he>).
